text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
We sure have taken down a bunch of them.
They don't stand a chance when we're together, huh? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
たくさん倒したけど、
私とお兄ちゃんがいれば当然だよね♪

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
There's still plenty left, though.
Keep powering me up, {0}.
I'll kick all their butts. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
フォギーはまだいるみたい……
お兄ちゃん、
フォギーにお仕置きするために、
私に力を貸してね♪
